stem: How does a vision model read an image?
options: By querying a database of images
It turns the image into tokens and runs the same next-token machinery as for text
explanation: Same loop, different input; which is why images cost tokens and why image-derived facts are recognised, not known.

stem: A value the model read from an invoice image should be…
options: Trusted — the schema guaranteed a number
Trusted if the model is confident
Verified like OCR output: arithmetic, format, range, cross-references; human on failure
explanation: Schema pins the shape; the value came from pixel recognition and may be misread or inferred.

stem: When should you OCR (or use the PDF text layer) instead of sending the image?
options: When the image is text — invoices, forms, contracts — and layout does not carry the meaning
Only when the model has no vision
explanation: Text is far cheaper in tokens and usually more accurate for dense text; send images for layout, charts, photos.

options: About the same as its text
Hundreds to thousands of input tokens, far more than the text it contains
explanation: Budget images: downscale, crop, send pages that matter.

stem: Subtotal 915.00, VAT 173.85, total_due read as 1,088.58. What catches it?
options: An arithmetic check: subtotal + VAT != total
explanation: Transposed digits are classic OCR misreads; the consistency check is cheap and decisive.

stem: Downscaling an image too far causes…
options: Small print and decimals to be misread first — pick a floor from where your documents start failing
explanation: Find the resolution floor empirically on your own documents.

stem: Your team wants to send whole 40-page PDFs as images 'for context'. The right advice is…
options: Use the text layer, chunk, retrieve the relevant parts; send images only where layout matters
Do it — more context is better
explanation: Pages as images are huge in tokens and the middle gets lost (2.5); retrieval sends less and better.

stem: A risk specific to image extraction versus OCR is…
options: The model may infer a plausible value that is not actually on the page
explanation: Generative models fill gaps; verification and cross-references catch inventions.

stem: For 10,000 invoices a day, the model's place is…
options: Reading every pixel of every page
The judgement step after OCR/layout extraction, with code verification and a human queue for failures
explanation: Dedicated OCR for recognition, the LLM for structure and judgement, code for checks, humans for exceptions.

stem: Which model reads your documents best is decided by…
options: An eval on your own documents
explanation: Vision accuracy varies by document type; measure before choosing.
